action: Cuts the head mass into big flat facets with straight planar slices drawn across the silhouette while the 2D Frieren line-art sits on the second monitor.
tool: Slice/Trim curve stroke on a DynaMesh head (overlay reads 'SLICE ... Angle')
why: Establish the faceted anime head silhouette (cranium, cheek, jaw planes) before any soft forms.
reader_equivalent: Bisect with fill or boolean plane cuts on a low-res voxel-remeshed sphere; in Sculpt mode Line Project / Trim Line gesture, then Voxel Remesh at a coarse voxel size.

action: Adds a stepped horizontal brow shelf with a second set of planar cuts, so the eye socket band sits recessed under a flat forehead plane.
tool: Slice curve with angle snapping on DynaMesh
why: Place the brow line and eye band as one hard step that later becomes the eye area.
reader_equivalent: Trim Line / Line Project gesture in Sculpt mode, or Edit-mode knife + extrude inward, then voxel remesh.

action: Softens the faceted block with a large brush and pulls a small nose wedge out of the mid-face, keeping the brow step readable.
tool: Move / Smooth with large draw size (inferred), DynaMesh remesh
why: Go from blocky to soft only after the plane layout is set; nose is a minimal wedge.
reader_equivalent: Grab + Smooth at large radius, Snake Hook or Grab for the nose tip, Voxel Remesh to even topology.

action: Rotates to side/below to check the head volume, then starts cutting thin lines into the face surface.
why: Check skull depth and jaw from off-angles before committing facial lines.
reader_equivalent: Orbit view; Crease / Draw Sharp with small radius.

action: Draws the eye as raised/engraved line work on the flat eye band: upper lid line, lash flicks, lower lid, iris rings and brow, like inking the 2D drawing onto the clay.
tool: Fine line/crease brush at higher DynaMesh resolution (brush picked from custom brush palette)
why: Anime eyes are graphic lines on a near-flat plane rather than a modelled eyeball and lids.
reader_equivalent: Crease / Draw Sharp (small radius, high strength) or Draw with Stroke = Line/Curve on a flattened eye plane; Layer brush for raised lines.

action: Builds individual hair locks as separate low-poly strip meshes with polygroups (each lock a bent, flattened ribbon with a thick end), editing them in a polygroup-coloured view.
why: Each lock gets a clean controllable shape with crisp edges instead of sculpting hair out of one blob.
reader_equivalent: Edit-mode low-poly strip or curve-with-bevel per lock, face sets per lock, Subdivision Surface with edge creases, then apply.

action: Stacks many separate crescent-shaped locks over the skull, carves a groove along a single lock, and layers fringe locks over the forehead so they overlap like 2D hair shapes.
tool: Separate subtools per lock, Move, crease brush; brush palette popup
why: Hair volume is read as distinct overlapping ribbon locks with sharp edges and internal grooves.
reader_equivalent: Separate objects per lock (or curve hair with bevel), Grab to place, Crease to cut a lengthwise groove, Pinch to sharpen edges.

action: Models the choker/collar as a separate low-poly ring with polygroups and an inset band, editing polygons directly.
tool: ZModeler (on-screen hint 'Eliminar Un Polígono' / polygroup action)
why: Hard-surface accessories are clean low-poly geometry, not sculpted.
reader_equivalent: Edit-mode cylinder ring, Inset/Extrude faces, Bevel edges, Subdivision Surface.

action: Places the dangling earring under the pointed elf ear with the transform gizmo.
why: Accessories are separate pieces positioned with transform, not sculpted in place.
reader_equivalent: Object-mode G/R/S on a separate earring object, parented to the head.

action: Orbits the finished bust (long layered hair, pointed ears, choker, top) to review the whole silhouette from several angles.
why: Final check of silhouette and hair flow from multiple views.
reader_equivalent: Orbit with a clay matcap / turntable render.
